# Uzbekistan

> [!summary] Data available
> Covered only at regional level: the [[Central Asian Digital Visual Food Atlas]] (Uzbek names and portion weights) and the [[Central Asian Food Dataset]] (dish images) apply, but no dataset has Uzbek-specific recipes or composition. Knowledge bases give 5–10 dishes; [[CMAUP]] has 90 plants.

## Foods & dishes
- [[Central Asian Digital Visual Food Atlas]]: 115 regional items (95 foods at 3 portion weights in g, 20 beverages in ml), with local names in Kazakh, Uzbek, Kyrgyz, Tajik and Turkmen for 83–85 items; no per-item country, no nutrients.
- [[Central Asian Food Dataset]]: images only, no per-image country. CAFD 42 national dish classes (16,402 images on HF); CAFSD 21,306 meal-scene photos, 239 classes, 69,865 boxes.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 10 dishes, 0 Uzbekistan-only (plov is labelled Central Asian). [[FmLAMA]]: 5 dishes (96 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 2 dishes.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Uzbek FCT. The [[Kyrgyzstan Food Composition Table]] (11 national dishes shared across Central Asia: beshbarmak, plov, manty, lagman, shorpo, mastava) can be combined with the atlas portion weights to estimate nutrients per plate.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[CMAUP]]: 90 plants (89 scraped). [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 20 records (11 edible / 9 medicinal). [[NPASS]]: 28 species–compound pairs.
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Uzbek-specific recipes, composition, QA or traditional-medicine data.
